title: The Sleeping City
synopsis: The lamps behind the train go out, and the Hush is faster than ever. Ahead is an old city that has slept in the dark for years. Rook has an idea.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: the old city. Hold the bar!
The lamps behind us... they're going out.
It's right behind us. Full steam!
It's too fast. We can't outrun it.
The old power house! I have an idea.
Now lights off. Let it eat.
It ate the whole city. It sees us!
We made it. Sorry, old city.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
